scope: PR #14 second review: exact legacy snapshots, full recorded frame identity, decoded recording validity, explicit bundle identity, Demo process ownership and isolated performance records roots

reviewFixes.name: Exact legacy recipe versions
reviewFixes.behavior: Never synthesize a missing version from another saved recipe version. Corrective migration only associates an actual exact ID/version source or a transactionally proven runtime record; missing or ambiguous associations remain unavailable for reproduction.

reviewFixes.name: Full recorded frame identity
reviewFixes.behavior: Require part.json and match cycleId, k, shotId, camera, selectedView, session, ordinal, frameCounter and triggerCounter, plus view/file and decoded dimensions. Missing or mismatched metadata keeps the listed entry unavailable.

reviewFixes.name: Recording decode validation
reviewFixes.behavior: Finish decodes written images and checks actual dimensions. Same-length corrupt or resized PGM is rejected; other retained views remain partial evidence, without changing the original verdict.

reviewFixes.name: Explicit publication identity
reviewFixes.behavior: New bundles require the matching explicit bundleId on load and later verification. Only recognizable old-format manifests in old-format directories may use the persisted independent legacy ID mapping.

reviewFixes.name: Demo startup ownership
reviewFixes.behavior: A live owned process is never silently reused; startup requires the existing Demo to be stopped normally. PID/path/start identity checks remain in place.

reviewFixes.name: Isolated performance records root
reviewFixes.behavior: Accept only the explicit performance or performance.nohash identifier under the current C-drive APPDATA; reject another profile/user, relative paths and non-C paths.

legacyMigrationBoundary: Old-schema rows with NULL digest and an already assigned recipe_revision cannot distinguish an earlier synthesized association from a pre-provenance runtime record.

Without an original exact recipe ID/version snapshot or explicit_recipe_records provenance, corrective migration conservatively clears reproduction associations, including unprovable records from that mixed transition window.
Original rows, snapshot JSON, point data, raw references and ACK evidence are retained; this correction does not erase them or fall back to the current recipe.

Subsequent Store.insert writes explicit_recipe_records in the same transaction as snapshot/part/shots. Forced shot-write failure rolls the entire transaction back; history purge cascades the provenance row.

preservedFailures.correction: Two SQLite fixtures used invalid empty judgement JSON; replaced with a real serialized Judgement. The explicit bundle identity error message now retains the identity wording required by the existing test; production rejection and the assertion are unchanged.

limits: S7 production code is unchanged in this round; the earlier 24-test result is historical evidence and was not rerun here.
No frontend coverage, native desktop, Robot five-scenario or 400-part performance run is claimed for this review round.
The default noisy good fixture returning code 2 remains P0-09; strict good OK and original limits are not weakened.
PR #15 durable audit work and its validation are not part of this branch or this evidence.
No business content hash matching is restored; same-size valid pixel changes are not checked through content digests.
